flavorPatch: The mana flares; the caster pays in kind.
Two wounds, one echo.
Acid finds the seam in every ward.
Gold fuels the march; the mountain provides.
The market corners itself when the blade sets the price.
Hostile takeovers are settled in ash.
The earth cracks; fire answers.
Lava does not negotiate; it consumes.
Twin volleys; the mountain speaks twice.
Ash falls where the ember kissed.
The caldera opens; the valley fills with fire.
The ground shakes; the enemy breaks.
A dart of molten glass; small, sharp, final.
The burst does not ask permission.
Spray the forge; the metal remembers.
The hammer falls; the anvil screams.
The gale carries cinders, not mercy.
The trap springs; the intruder burns.
Ash chokes the sky; the living choke faster.
The quake splits the line; fire fills the gap.
Two brands; one forge.
The storm is cinder; the forecast is ruin.
